text:
nguyen: Hey all — first week here, trying to bootstrap my dev env. I'm on an M2 Mac primary but also have WSL Ubuntu for a couple of services. Installed Homebrew and asdf but hitting compile errors (openssl stuff) when installing Ruby and building some native npm modules. Also not sure which env vars Redwood expects locally (REDWOOD_API_KEY? KUBECONFIG?). Who should I ping for exact versions and quick checklist?

jordan: welcome! quick checklist that gets 95% there:
1) install brew (we prefer /opt/homebrew on M1/M2)
2) install asdf via brew or git clone
3) add plugins we use: nodejs, python, ruby, golang, terraform
4) use exact versions in the onboarding repo or run `asdf list-all <plugin>` to pick the stable ones

Install commands i use on mac:
```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"
brew install asdf direnv coreutils openssl@3
# asdf init in .zshrc or .bashrc
asdf plugin-add nodejs https://github.com/asdf-vm/asdf-nodejs.git || true
asdf install nodejs 18.20.0

# if Ruby fails to compile on mac M1/M2, set these first
export LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/lib"
export CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/include"
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/lib/pkgconfig"
```

On WSL (Ubuntu): `sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y build-essential libssl-dev zlib1g-dev` before asdf/ruby.

jordan: For native npm modules that use Rust (like some image libs), make sure `rustup` is installed and `~/.cargo/bin` is on PATH.

nguyen: thanks! where do i put REDWOOD_API_KEY and kube configs? do we commit anything or use direnv/sops?

elaine: don't commit secrets. we use direnv + vault for most things. For local dev you can put service keys in `~/.config/redwood/env` or just export them via direnv. Minimal pattern we recommend in onboarding repo:
```bash
# ~/.config/redwood/env (not checked in)
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=redacted
export REDWOOD_ENV=dev
export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/config-redwood
```
Then in your repo `.envrc` point to it: `source_env ~/.config/redwood/env`

elaine: dotfiles: we have a public-ish dotfiles starter at `https://github.com/redwood-onboarding/dotfiles` — it includes asdf init snippets, direnv hooks, and a sample `.gitconfig`. Clone it and copy what you need, but personalise keys. If you want the company defaults synced, ping infra for access and they'll add you to the dotfiles team.

nguyen: how do i add my SSH key to the org? I made an `ed25519` key.

elaine: add the pubkey to your GitHub account, then run the onboarding form (link in #new-hires pinned) to request access to internal repos. Infra will add your key to the internal deploy user if needed.

infra-bot: Created access ticket #INF-4821 for nguyen to get repo access. Expect an update from infra within 24-48h.

jordan: one more thing — for Python we prefer using `pyenv` via asdf plugin + `pipx` for CLI tools. For Node some folks like `corepack` + `pnpm`. If you want exact pinned versions, look at `onboarding/bootstraps/` in the repo.

nguyen: awesome, this is super helpful. i'll try the OpenSSL env vars and direnv flow, then post logs here if i still fail. thanks folks :rocket:
